description: Land Acquisition - Dambulla Town, Dambulla D/S Division, Matale District
categorisation: This gazette notice is a land acquisition notice published under the Land Acquisition Act, specifically detailing the government's intention to acquire 18 lots of land in Dambulla for public purposes. It contains detailed descriptions of each land parcel, including names, descriptions, claimants, and extents. The content is exclusively focused on land matters, falling squarely under the Land Gazettes category (Type 4) which covers land acquisitions, transfers, and property-related administrative actions.
